instruction: Candid action photograph, medium shot at eye-level. Under a covered outdoor pavilion with white metal trusses and blue pillars, two young men are sparring. On the left, the boxer in the blue tank top (R2) faces right, tightly blocking with his gloves covering his face. On the right, the boxer in the beige t-shirt (R1) stands with his back to the camera, throwing a right-hand punch. The boxer in the beige t-shirt (R1) strikes with a right punch while the boxer in the blue tank top (R2) maintains a tight defensive block. The scene is illuminated by bright, natural daylight with soft shadows.
elements: R1 is the attacking boxer throwing a right-hand punch while R2 is the defending boxer blocking
R2 maintains a tight defensive block with gloves covering his face rather than punching R1
R1's punch is directed at R2 while R2 protects himself from that punch
R2's boxing gloves are raised to cover his face for defense
The sparring takes place under a covered outdoor pavilion with white metal trusses and blue pillars
